items.title: Ludwig Kaiser Motion To Dismiss Battery Case Denied
items.desc: Per Fightful Select citing court records, a judge denied Ludwig Kaiser's July motion to dismiss his battery charge under Florida's Stand Your Ground law during a Monday hearing. A pre-trial conference is scheduled for December 17.

items.title: Santino Marella Signs New TNA Deal
items.desc: TNA announced that Santino Marella has signed a new contract with the promotion. The deal keeps the veteran wrestler and on-screen personality with the company beyond his previous agreement.

items.title: KAIRI Confirms Plans In Motion For Wrestling Return
items.desc: KAIRI was released from WWE in April and has not appeared for any promotion since her contract ended in July. In a new interview she stated that various things are already in motion for her next wrestling chapter though she could not share specifics yet.

items.title: Dragon Lee Re-Signs With WWE
items.desc: PWInsider reports that Dragon Lee has re-signed with WWE. The luchador originally joined the company in January 2023 and made his television debut two months later.

items.title: Clark Connors Shares Original Name Idea for The Dogs
items.desc: Clark Connors revealed that he, David Finlay and El Phantasmo wanted to call themselves Raw Dogs upon arriving in AEW but ultimately went with The Dogs. Connors noted the name had never been used before and that the alternative carried potential issues tied to Monday Night.

items.title: Steven Borden returns on Dynamite, calls for Blood & Guts
items.desc: Steven Borden made his return to AEW Dynamite after suffering an injury at All Out. He joined the ring brawl following the Young Bucks' loss to Mark Davis and Jake Doyle, then announced on the microphone that he would be part of next month's Blood & Guts match in Jacksonville.

items.title: TNA Signs Newly Crowned Knockouts Tag Champion Shayna Baszler
items.desc: TNA Wrestling has signed Shayna Baszler to a contract after she and Zoey Serrano defeated Allie and Kiera Hogan at Bound for Glory on October 11 to win the Knockouts Tag Team titles. The team is now known as Apex in TNA.

items.desc: Former Michigan State shot putter Elly Finch has signed a developmental contract with WWE after participating in the company's tryouts over SummerSlam weekend. items.desc: All 4 confirmed results from TNA iMPACT! on October 22. Indi Hartwell beat Xia Brookside by referee stoppage to retain.

items.title: WWE SmackDown Preview For October 23
items.desc: Tonight's WWE Friday Night SmackDown airs on USA Network and Netflix from the Toyota Arena in Ontario, California. The scheduled match features WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Alexa Bliss and Tatum Paxley facing Michin and B-Fab.

items.title: Ric Flair Hospitalized After Fall in Tampa
items.desc: Ric Flair, 77, fell outside a Wagamama restaurant in Tampa, Florida on Friday, cutting his head and eye open and causing extensive bleeding. He was transported by ambulance to a local hospital, where he may also have suffered a concussion.

items.desc: Dax Harwood discussed AEW's 2026 talent acquisitions including Maya World, Hyan, Motor City Machine Guns, Ilja Dragunov and The New Level. In an interview, he said the additions will help the company continue to grow and that he supports anyone who shares that goal.

items.title: Vic Joseph to Host NXT Beyond The Bell on CW
items.desc: Vic Joseph announced he will co-host a new interview series called NXT Beyond The Bell alongside Blake Howard. The show will air on the CW Network and feature in-depth stories on WWE NXT talent.

items.title: Stone Cold Steve Austin's 1999 Knee Brace Sells for $225,700
items.desc: A match-worn and signed knee brace from circa 1999 used by Stone Cold Steve Austin sold at auction for $225,700. The DonJoy brace, which includes a WWE letter signed by Linda McMahon, was listed through Heritage Auctions.

items.desc: Channing “Stacks” Lorenzo suffered an injury during an eight-man tag match at the WWE NXT house show in Sudbury, Ontario on October 16 that forced the bout to be stopped. He was taken to a local hospital for evaluation after taking a backdrop to the floor.

items.title: Match Made: John Cena appearance, Royce Keys vs. Solo Sikoa set for next WWE Raw
items.desc: John Cena will appear on next week's episode of WWE Raw at the Barclays Center in Brooklyn. A singles match pitting Solo Sikoa against Royce Keys has also been confirmed for the show.

items.title: Tony D'Angelo Says NXT Roster Inexperience Hurt His Title Run
items.desc: Tony D'Angelo discussed his WWE NXT Championship reign with Denise Salcedo. He explained that the inexperience of much of the roster limited his options for opponents and strong matches, as many veterans had been moved to the main roster.

items.title: Shotzi Blackheart Reveals WWE Blocked TNA Run
items.desc: Shotzi Blackheart disclosed in a Generation Of Wrestling Podcast interview that she requested permission from WWE to wrestle in TNA after returning from ACL surgery in 2024. She spoke with Tommy Dreamer who was receptive but WWE executives denied the request.

items.title: Grayson Waller Eyes WWE Title After Near-Release Scare
items.desc: Grayson Waller told the Insight Podcast he is now fully committed to one day becoming WWE Champion after revamping his character and proving himself as a serious in-ring competitor. Waller said he sees an opening on the main roster for his updated persona and plans to seize it upon his return.

items.desc: Tommaso Ciampa attempted to recreate his old WWE bit by hitting an RKO out of nowhere in Randy Orton's hometown of St. Louis during AEW Fright Night Dynamite and Collision week.

items.title: ‘The Demon’ Finn Balor emerges on WWE SmackDown
items.desc: On the Halloween edition of WWE SmackDown, The Demon version of Finn Balor made a surprise appearance to save Danhausen from Gunther. Balor attacked Gunther with a Coup de Grace off a ladder through the announce table after Danhausen summoned him with a curse.

items.title: AEW Drops Scariest Wrestling Matches Compilation
items.desc: All Elite Wrestling has released a 31-minute video compilation titled Scariest Wrestling Matches. The video features some of the most frightening moments from AEW's history and was made available on Halloween.

items.title: Darren Young Returns to WWE NXT in New Role
items.desc: Almost a decade after his WWE release, Fred Rosser has returned to the company as a coach at NXT. The former wrestler, last seen in action at a 2026 independent event, shared his emotional homecoming on social media while emphasizing his desire to help develop the next generation of talent.

items.title: Fred Rosser Returns to NXT as Coach
items.desc: Fred Rosser, who previously wrestled in WWE as Darren Young, has taken on a coaching position with NXT. He shared his excitement about returning to the WWE Performance Center and his desire to help develop new talent while learning current company standards.

items.title: Canelo Álvarez regains WBC Super Middleweight Title
items.desc: Canelo Álvarez defeated Christian Mbilli by unanimous decision with scores of 115-112, 116-111 and 117-110 to reclaim the WBC Super Middleweight Championship in the main event of Saturday's boxing card in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The bout took place at The Venue without any reported security issues…

items.title: Celebration Of Life For WWE Sign Guy Set For November 27
items.desc: A celebration of life for Rick Achberger, known as the WWE Sign Guy, is scheduled for November 27 from 12 pm to 2 pm at Kelly’s Restaurant & Bar in Frisco, Texas. Achberger passed away on September 27, prompting tributes from numerous WWE wrestlers on social media.

items.title: Maclin Says WWE Release Inspired Ruthless TNA Character
items.desc: Steve Maclin explained that his 2021 WWE release directly motivated the aggressive persona he brought to TNA that June. He credited the mindset for helping him capture the TNA World Championship, become a two-time TNA International Champion and become the first to achieve that feat.

items.title: Santino Marella Praises NXT's BirthRight For Outworking Critics
items.desc: Santino Marella discussed the unique pressures faced by Lexis King, Uriah Connors, Charlie Dempsey and Arianna Grace in WWE NXT. He noted that the group works extremely hard to exceed expectations and prevent accusations that they only receive opportunities due to their family backgrounds.

items.title: Cody Rhodes enters John Cena Classic
items.desc: The John Cena Classic is scheduled for December 14 at Walt Disney World in Orlando. Wrestlers from Raw and SmackDown will compete against those from NXT with Club WWE members voting at the end of the night to crown the John Cena Classic Champion.

items.title: Lucha Libre AAA Adds New Live Tour Dates
items.desc: WWE's Lucha Libre AAA brand has announced additional dates for its upcoming live tour, including stops in Odessa, Sacramento and Fresno. The news was shared via the promotion's official social media on November 3.

items.title: AEW SVP Justin Street Returns to PBR
items.desc: Justin Street has left his position as AEW Senior Vice President of Corporate Partnerships and Sales after one year with the company. items.title: WWE Releases Multiple New Videos

items.title: Taya Valkyrie Leaves AEW After Turning Down Extension
items.desc: Taya Valkyrie announced her departure from AEW after more than three years with the company. She turned down a contract extension offer and expressed gratitude for her time there, the talent she worked with, and the relationships she built.

items.title: NXT Tag Title Match Set For Next Week

items.title: AEW Filming Darby Allin's Everest Climb
items.desc: Per PWInsider, AEW shot footage of Darby Allin scaling Mount Everest as part of his side projects. The promotion is looking to capitalize on his non-wrestling adventures such as climbing Everest and running the New York City Marathon.

items.title: WWE Offers $3,000 Hazard Pay for Saudi Arabia Crew
items.desc: Per Fightful Select, WWE offered crew members $3,000 in hazard pay for the upcoming Crown Jewel event in Riyadh. Several crew members have chosen not to make the trip despite the extra compensation.

items.title: Stephanie Vaquer Returns at WWE Live Event
items.desc: Stephanie Vaquer made a surprise return to the ring on Thursday at a WWE live event in Portland, Maine. She teamed with IYO SKY and Lola Vice to face Fatal Influence in a trios match.

items.title: Super Grudges. Super Rivals. Super Debuts. Super Title Fights. — Saturday Night SuperFight
items.desc: Killer Kross faces the only man to ever pin him in MLW. Matt Riddle looks to settle his score with Austin Aries.

items.title: Rey Mysterio Announces Team Mexico vs. Team USA Elimination Match For Survivor Series 2026
items.desc: Rey Mysterio revealed on Stephanie McMahon's podcast that WWE Survivor Series 2026 will include a 5 vs. 5 Elimination Tag Team match pitting Team Mexico against Team USA. He indicated that the teams will involve stars from Raw and SmackDown, with possible AAA involvement.
